scope: Review source evidence relevant to possible L03 interaction/structure patterns without promoting any productive pattern, assigning OPI/QA/Structure slots, or authoring HNK sentences.

evidence_findings.finding: First-person AN evidence exists in recovered course material, but it does not license a productive declarative template for L03 or establish general AN+predicate word order.
SARU has source-backed lexical evidence for todos os dias / habitualidade only; it is not established as usually and does not license habitual/frequency grammar.
SALI=precisar (WATCH) and DAYI=querer/intenção (CANDIDATE/PARTIAL) provide lexical evidence only. Modal syntax, complement structure, future and planning realization remain unresolved.
TA has destination/purpose evidence only; position, scope, attachment and productivity remain unresolved.
No prior-lesson functional token, including AN, EN, KE, NE, KUVAN or KU, enters L03 automatically by inheritance. Each requires direct scoped evidence or a separate approved gate.
No source currently licenses deriving an L03 declarative by merely removing KE from a question, rearranging tokens, or applying analogy from L01/L02.
